caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

GPT-4 processed more text than you could read in 20,000 lifetimes! That's an incomprehensible amount of information!

Here's why that's mind-blowing:
🔹 GPT-4's training involved roughly 13 trillion 'tokens' – these are AI's tiny text building blocks, like parts of words.
🔹 If a human read 250 words per minute nonstop, it would take over 20,000 years to match that input!
🔹 This immense training allows AI models to understand, generate, and learn from vast amounts of information, making them digital super-brains!
